project_description: Extend Go-LIP's conservative canonical native tool-call repair with bounded safe terminal-tail recovery for a trailing comma after a complete JSON value and an explicit final top-level property whose missing value is selected by the existing deterministic-fill policy, while preserving exact-original fail-open replay, applicable compiled-schema post-validation, empty-schema syntax-only safeguards, streaming-first execution, and strict refusal of speculative repairs.
